bodyMarkdown:
## Dermal Therapist Salary: Hourly to Annual Conversion

Understanding your **dermal therapist salary** starts with knowing how to convert an hourly rate to an annual figure. Whether you are negotiating a job offer or checking your pay, the formula is straightforward: multiply your hourly rate by the number of hours you work each week, then by 52 weeks. For a full-time dermal therapist, that usually means 38 hours per week.

### The Basic Formula

Annual gross pay = hourly rate × hours per week × 52

For example, if your base hourly rate is $30.00 and you work 38 hours each week:

$30.00 × 38 × 52 = $59,280 per year

This calculation assumes the same rate every week, no unpaid overtime, and no penalty rates or allowances. It is a useful starting point, but your actual pay may differ if you work irregular hours or receive additional payments.

### Award Rates for Dermal Therapists

Most dermal therapists are covered by the **Health Professionals and Support Services Award 2020** [pay guides](/blog). From 1 July 2026, award minimum wages increased by 4.75% following the Fair Work Commission’s Annual Wage Review. The exact classification level depends on your qualifications and duties. The National Minimum Wage is $26.44 per hour for award/agreement-free employees, but award rates are typically higher. Always check the specific award classification for your role.

### Casual Loading and Superannuation

If you work as a casual dermal therapist, you are entitled to a **25% casual loading** on top of the base hourly rate [casual loading](/topics/casual-loading). This loading compensates for the lack of paid leave and other entitlements. For a casual dermal therapist on the National Minimum Wage, the casual rate would be $33.05 per hour ($26.44 × 1.25).

**Superannuation** is paid on top of your ordinary earnings. The super guarantee is 12% for the 2026–27 financial year, up to the maximum contribution base of $270,830. If your annual gross salary is $59,280, your employer would contribute an extra $7,113.60 in super. This is not deducted from your pay – it is an additional benefit.

### Fortnightly and Weekly Pay

Many employers pay fortnightly. To find your fortnightly gross pay, multiply your weekly pay by two. Using the example above:

Weekly: $30.00 × 38 = $1,140.00
Fortnightly: $1,140.00 × 2 = $2,280.00

Your take-home pay will be less after tax and the Medicare levy. For the 2026–27 resident tax rates, the first $18,200 is tax-free, then 15% up to $45,000, 30% up to $135,000, 37% up to $190,000, and 45% above that. The Medicare levy is generally 2% of your taxable income. Use the [take-home pay](/topics/take-home) calculator for a more detailed estimate.

### Using the Hourly to Annual Timesheet

The [timesheet](/) on this site lets you enter your base hourly rate and optionally add the 25% casual loading. It then calculates your annual gross pay, superannuation, and estimated tax. Remember: **do not** enter a rate that already includes casual loading – tick the checkbox instead. The tool assumes 38 hours per week unless you change it.

### Why the National Minimum Wage Matters

The National Minimum Wage sets the floor for all award/agreement-free employees. From 1 July 2026, it is $1,004.90 per week for 38 hours ($26.44 per hour) [minimum wage](/topics/minimum-wage). If your dermal therapist salary is below this, it may be unlawful. Most dermal therapists are covered by an award with higher minimums, so always compare your rate to the relevant award.

### Superannuation Paid on Top

Super is calculated on your ordinary time earnings. If you earn $59,280 per year, the super guarantee adds $7,113.60, making your total remuneration $66,393.60. The maximum contribution base means super is capped once your earnings exceed $270,830. For most dermal therapists, this cap does not apply.

### Tax and Medicare

Tax is withheld from each pay. The 2026–27 resident tax rates apply, with the tax-free threshold of $18,200. The Medicare levy is 2% for most singles. If you have a HELP debt or are liable for the Medicare levy surcharge, those amounts are not included in this estimate. See the [super and packaging](/topics/super-and-packaging) page for more on salary packaging.

### Summary

Converting your dermal therapist salary from hourly to annual is simple: hourly × 38 × 52. Add casual loading if applicable, and remember super is paid on top. Use the [timesheet](/) to run your own numbers, and always check the Fair Work Ombudsman pay guides for the most current award rates. The Fair Work Commission’s Modern Awards Pay Database provides detailed classification and penalty rate data.

*Disclaimer: Annual pay here is hourly rate × hours per week × 52. It assumes the same rate every week, no unpaid overtime, no penalty rates, no allowances, and no salary sacrifice. Super is estimated at 12% of ordinary earnings only, paid on top, and stops at the $270,830 maximum contribution base. Tax is the 2026–27 resident scale with the full tax-free threshold. Medicare uses the 2025–26 single reduction thresholds because the 2026–27 reduction thresholds were not confirmed here. HELP, the Medicare levy surcharge, and salary packaging are not deducted. This is an estimate, not a determination of your pay or tax.*
